What Are Non GamStop Casinos?

While this is a valuable tool for many, it can limit players' options during their exclusion period.

Non-GamStop casinos typically hold licences from international jurisdictions such as Curacao or Malta, which means they are not subject to UKGC regulations. As a result, these casinos can offer a wider variety of games, larger bonuses, and different payment options compared to UKGC-licensed sites. What to Watch Out For

When considering bonuses at non-GamStop casinos, it is essential to be aware of certain factors:

  • Wagering Requirements: These can vary significantly between casinos, typically ranging from x30 to x50. This means players must wager a certain multiple of the bonus amount before they can withdraw winnings.

  • Game Weighting: Not all games contribute equally towards wagering requirements. Slots usually contribute 100%, while table games may contribute less.

  • Maximum Bet Rules: Players should be cautious of rules that limit the maximum bet allowed while using bonus funds, as breaching these can result in forfeiting winnings.

  • Time Limits: Bonuses often come with expiration dates, requiring players to use them within a specified timeframe.

  • Maximum Withdrawal Limits: Some bonuses may impose caps on how much players can withdraw from bonus winnings.

  • Sticky vs Non-Sticky Bonuses: Players should understand whether their bonus is sticky (where the bonus is deducted before withdrawals) or non-sticky (where players can withdraw their deposit but not the bonus).

Understanding these terms can help players make informed decisions and maximise their gaming experience at non-GamStop casinos UK.
